scripts.studio: npm run gen && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.preview: npm run gen && remotion render src/index.ts HaksLoop out/haks_preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=26 --concurrency=4
scripts.render: npm run gen && remotion render src/index.ts HaksLoop out/haks_loop_raw.mp4 --crf=16 --concurrency=4 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/haks_loop_raw.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart out/haks_loop_10s.mp4 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -stream_loop 2 -i out/haks_loop_raw.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart out/haks_loop_30s.mp4
